turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Liew from the anesthesia team. Today, we'll go through some questions to prepare you for your hip replacement surgery. Let's start with why you're having this surgery. Can you tell me about your left hip problem?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, doctor. My left hip been hurting a lot for years, lah. Can't walk far, even with cane. X-ray show bad arthritis, so doctor say need to replace it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Now, let's review your medications. Your records list amlodipine, metformin, and atorvastatin. Are you still taking all these?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Amlodipine and atorvastatin still taking every day, doctor. But metformin... stopped already one year plus.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Metformin was stopped? Can you tell me why?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, doctor. My sugar level very good on diet alone. HbA1c last check was 6.2%, so doctor say can stop metformin.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: I see. We'll update your records. Any allergies? Your file mentions penicillin causes a rash.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, doctor. Once take penicillin, body get red spots. Never take again after that.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Noted. Have you had anything to eat or drink since midnight?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doctor. Wife make sure I NPO from last night. Only sip water for meds.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Any previous surgeries or anesthesia? Any problems during those times?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Had gallbladder out ten years back. Anesthesia okay, wake up no problem. No dizziness or vomiting.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Finally, how's your mobility now? Can you walk with assistance?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Can walk short distance with cane, but pain very bad. Need help for stairs or long walks.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. We'll proceed with spinal anesthesia and propofol sedation as planned. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, doctor. All clear. Thank you for explaining everything.
